deciding.eligibility_proven: Lab requisition S-0421 differs from S-0412, consent is on a superseded version with no re-consent, sign-off is missing and 2 queries are open; the values themselves match.
deciding.next_step: Identifier and consent defects with two open queries could mean hold_query or exclusion/screen_fail; nothing shows a criterion definitively failed.
deciding.primary_issue: Requisition screening number differs from the subject's, and consent version 2.0 is not current 3.0 with empty reconsent; both are documentation defects.
deciding.affected_scope: Documentation defect on a consent form version and the lab requisition could touch a whole site or version cohort, but only one subject's record shows it; 6-20 and more than 20 are both defensible.
deciding.window_left: Signed 2024-03-01 plus 16 days is 2024-03-17, so 5 days remain at the 2024-03-12 review, on the border of the 4-10 level and above 10 only if counted from the visit date.
